description.en: Tells whether every player of the team has full GP. It looks at the first 16 members of the party list (at most 16; a match team being 11 players and 5 substitutes, probably the team's lineup). It returns false as soon as one of them has less GP than their maximum.

true if all of them have full GP, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or the player data is not available.

examples.case: Checking the team's GP (not found in script_clean/; invented)
